card.name: Words just before "excluded" or "ruled out"
card.fires_on: Small words (is, be, the, pre) and "ruled" right before a form of "exclude" or "rule out". Typical settings are "cannot be excluded" and "until pregnancy is excluded".

modes.label: Cannot be excluded
modes.description: The word "be" after "cannot" where "excluded" or "ruled out" comes next.
modes.example: a contribution of pramipexole cannot<< be>> completely ruled

modes.label: Pregnancy excluded
modes.description: The word "is" or "ruled" in statements that pregnancy must be excluded before treatment.
modes.example: Females of reproductive potential must not be given a prescription for acitretin until pregnancy<< is>> excluded.

modes.label: Other exclusion wording
modes.description: Words that begin or lead into "preclude" or "exclusion" in other settings.
modes.example: A negative scan result does not<< pre>>clude the accumulation of amyloid beta in

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "exclude", "exclusion" and similar words next.
card.plain: It fires on the word right before "excluded" or "ruled out", as in "cannot be excluded".
